mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances; metronidazole may potentiate zoledronic acid's renal effects, and combined use increases risk of acute kidney injury and hypocalcemia.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
